site.audience: patients seeking doctors and healthcare appointments

brief.title: MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly
brief.one_liner: An online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking.
brief.goal: Enable patients to search for healthcare providers by specialty, location, and insurance, read verified reviews, and book appointments online in minutes.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page where patients can search for doctors by specialty, condition, or provider name, view popular specialties, understand how the platform works, and be encouraged to book an appointment.

interactions.trigger: User types a specialty, doctor name, or condition into the search bar and selects a location
interactions.expected: Dropdown suggestions appear as user types; submitting the form navigates to search results

interactions.trigger: User clicks on a specialty card such as Dentist or Primary Care
interactions.expected: Navigates to a filtered search results page for that specialty

interactions.trigger: User taps the hamburger menu icon on mobile
interactions.expected: A slide-out navigation menu appears with links to Browse, Log In, and Sign Up

data_display.description: Grid of popular medical specialties users can browse to find providers
Key platform metrics highlighting scale, trust, and value proposition

expected_content: Search for a provider by specialty or condition
Choose a time that works for you
data_display.description: Step-by-step guide explaining how patients use the platform to find and book doctors
